methodology.scope: All built HTML, including self-canonical support and localized legal outside the sitemap; all 81 instructional pages are evaluated as both sources and targets.
methodology.relationship_review: Reviewed published words, constituent phonemes, normalized contrast families, related onset contrasts, actual source-language/L1 explanations, native hub methods, and existing training/navigation contexts. Exact-pair scan supplements semantic review; it does not assign links from keywords alone.
methodology.localized_policy: Keep native anchors and English target words; prefer a published same-language exact pair or method hub. Retain explicit English practice fallback only where no same-language equivalent exists. L1 denotes page context, not inferred visitor identity. hi-ur is the Hindi route; yue serves Traditional Chinese/Cantonese context.
methodology.placement_policy: Add reader actions at definitions, practice examples/steps, useful method explanations, or explicit L1 choices. Preserve nearby working directories and reviewed journeys; avoid linking every repeated example or broad term.
methodology.counts: Added links are HTML anchor occurrences, distinct graph edges are source/target pairs. A new occurrence can improve placement while its destination relationship already existed.
methodology.contextual_graph_definition: Existing repository validator includes breadcrumbs and content, excludes global header/footer/language selector. Additional body-only inbound sets below exclude breadcrumbs/TOC. Global graph summary covers all 114 built pages; eligible target metrics cover 81 instructional pages.
methodology.indexability: The existing validator calls only the 82 sitemap members indexable; this audit also reads self-canonical support and 28 localized legal pages outside the sitemap.
methodology.coverage_limit: No arbitrary source, target, or occurrence cap. Candidates were rejected for redundancy, misleading meaning, absent routes, or acquisition/legal purpose.
